[element-issue-part]
=== `<issue-part>` Issue Part (in a citation)

Within a citation (such as a <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>> or an <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>), used for the case when a publisher splits a journal issue into two or more separately bound or separately issued parts. This element holds the identifiers (titles, part numbers, etc.) for those publishing components.

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>

Text, numbers, or special characters, zero or more
